system.name: Coach
system.one_liner: a cloud platform system that exploits temporal patterns for all-resource oversubscription using long-term prediction and VM scheduling

components.name: Cluster Manager
components.role: converts a VM request into resource requirements and oversubscription rates using a prediction model

components.name: Prediction Model
components.role: decides oversubscription rates for each resource per time window

components.name: Cluster Scheduler
components.role: assigns the VM to a server using the computed rates and a scheduling policy

components.name: Scheduling Policy
components.role: policy used by the Cluster Scheduler to place the VM on a server

components.name: Server Manager
components.role: per-server component running the Oversubscription Agent

components.name: Oversubscription Agent
components.role: local agent that manages resources on the server and adjusts guaranteed/oversubscribed portions

components.name: Monitoring
components.role: monitors oversubscribed resources on the server to detect contention

components.name: Prediction
components.role: predicts resource needs to inform mitigation actions

components.name: Mitigation
components.role: mitigates detected contention via reactive and proactive actions

components.name: Reactive
components.role: reactive mitigation strategy triggered by detected contention

components.name: Action
components.role: mitigation action taken to adjust resource allocation, derived from Reactive/Proactive strategies

components.name: Backing Store
components.role: cold memory storage backing oversubscribed memory on the server

components.name: Memory
components.role: server memory divided into Guaranteed and Oversubscribed regions across VMs

components.name: Guaranteed
components.role: portion of memory guaranteed to each VM (GPVM1, CVM2, CVM3)

components.name: Oversubscribed
components.role: portion of memory oversubscribed and shared/unallocated across CVMs

components.name: General Purpose VM 1
components.role: a standard VM with only a guaranteed memory allocation

components.name: CoachVM 2
components.role: a CoachVM with both guaranteed and oversubscribed memory portions

components.name: CoachVM 3
components.role: a CoachVM with both guaranteed and oversubscribed memory portions

flows.what: cold memory swapped for oversubscribed portions

content.key_idea: Coach splits into a cluster-level manager/scheduler that predicts oversubscription rates and places CoachVMs, and a per-server oversubscription agent that monitors, predicts, and mitigates contention while dynamically partitioning each VM's memory into guaranteed and oversubscribed portions.

summary: This figure presents the design overview of Coach, a system for temporal-pattern-based all-resource oversubscription in cloud platforms. At the cluster level, a Cluster Manager uses a Prediction Model to convert incoming VM Requests into resource requirements and per-time-window oversubscription rates, which a Cluster Scheduler (via its Scheduling Policy) uses to allocate the VM to a server; the server reports VM Utilization back to the Cluster Manager. At the server level, a Server Manager runs an Oversubscription Agent combining Monitoring, Prediction, and Mitigation (with Reactive and Proactive strategies feeding an Action) to manage the server's Memory, partitioned into Guaranteed and Oversubscribed bands, backed by a Backing Store for cold memory. A bottom strip maps this scheme onto concrete VM instances: a General Purpose VM with only guaranteed memory, and two CoachVMs each split into guaranteed and oversubscribed portions. Dashed boxes separate the Cluster and Server regions, and color-coded bars visualize the guaranteed/oversubscribed memory split per VM.
